info.title: Michelangelo Public API
info.description:
Public API of the Michelangelo platform. This is the stable contract for the community: plugins, SDKs, MCP servers and third-party apps integrate here — never directly with the underlying backend.
Design rules (see ADR 0001): - Every long-running operation is an async **job** with state in the DB. - Auth is OAuth 2.1 + PKCE (Supabase as identity provider); tokens are
  standard Supabase JWTs validated via JWKS.
- All routes are versioned under `/v1`. Breaking changes ship as `/v2`.

get.summary: OpenAPI document as JSON — SDK generator feed
get.description: Serves this very contract (`openapi/v1.yaml`) as JSON. Feed it to OpenAPI Generator, hey-api, orval, Postman/Insomnia — or open `GET /v1/docs` — to build a client without asking anyone. No authentication required.
Human-friendly reference rendered from `GET /v1/openapi.json`. No authentication required to open it (calling the listed endpoints still needs a token).

200.description: HTML page hosting the Scalar API reference

get.summary: Return the identity behind the current access token
get.description: Cheap endpoint for clients to validate a token and discover the user, the OAuth client it was issued to, and the granted scopes. Backed by JWKS validation only — no upstream call required.

get.summary: Get current user profile — sparse fieldsets
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile (`user_id` always included). Pass `?fields=username,email,avatar_url` to fetch only what you need: `email` comes straight from the validated JWT (zero DB cost), `username`/`avatar_url` are read from `public.profiles` with a column-select limited to the requested fields. Omit `fields` to get everything at once. Unknown field names → 400 `invalid_fields`. Data sources verified on Supabase: `username`+`avatar_url` live in `public.profiles` (e.g. `jack` → `.../storage/v1/object/public/avatars/...`), `email` lives only in `auth.users` so the API serves the JWT `email` claim instead of hitting `auth.*` over PostgREST.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of `username,email,avatar_url`. Example: `?fields=username,email`. Omit for the full profile.

200.description: Current user profile (only requested fields + user_id)

patch.description: Updates `public.profiles` as the user (RLS `Users can update own profile`). Accepts `username` (3..30 chars, `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$`) and/or `avatar_url` (public URL or null to remove). Mirrors `src/screens/settings/edit-username.tsx` + `edit-profile.tsx` in michelangelo-app. Duplicate username → 409 `username_taken`.

delete.summary: Delete account and data (proxies delete-account edge)
delete.description: Proxies the Supabase `delete-account` edge function with the user JWT (no body). The edge removes files, notifications, github links, avatar objects, then `auth.admin.deleteUser` (cascades profiles, projects, usage_events, subscriptions, reshares, reports, blocks).

post.description: Accepts `multipart/form-data` with a single `file` field (png/jpeg/webp, max 5MB — same limits as `edit-profile.tsx:uploadImage`). Uploads to the public `avatars` bucket at `{user_id}/avatar_{ts}.{ext}` via service role, then updates `profiles.avatar_url` with the public URL. Returns the URL.

get.summary: Public profile by id (mirrors screens/user feed hero)
get.description: Selects `id,username,avatar_url,is_supporter,created_at,updated_at` from `public.profiles` — the exact column set `screens/user/index.tsx` reads. RLS `Profiles are viewable by everyone`, so any authenticated caller can read any profile (needed by explore feed, preview and user screens). Pairs with the `author` embed on Project.

post.description:
Creates a job row (`status: queued`) and returns immediately with the row. The HTTP request never waits for the work itself — poll `GET /jobs/{jobId}` on the `status` field for progress. Status transitions are written directly to the jobs table.
`type=prompt` (existing): `input.prompt` is evaluated server-side (invalid → 400, quota → 429, overdraft floor → 402 `insufficient_credits`). Small overdraft is allowed: a user with 1 cent still runs and goes negative, the next top-up absorbs the red. Accepts a top-level `attachments` manifest from `POST /jobs/attachments` (stored in `job_attachments`, mirrored into `input.attachment_refs` for the runner) and         `expo_push_token` (stored in `input`, used for completion push). Top-level `live_activity_token`, `live_activity_user` and `supabase_project_ref` are folded into `input` the same way (top-level wins on conflict with `input` keys); the legacy in-`input` shape keeps working. `idempotency_key` (uuid): retry with the same key returns the existing job (200) instead of creating a duplicate.
`type=github-push` (new): needs `project_id` of a GitHub-linked project. Creates the row, synchronously invokes the `github-actions` push (Snack bundle → GitHub), then writes `succeeded`/`failed` with `{pushed,commitSha}` into the row. Requires the `github-push` value in the `jobs_type_check` constraint (migration `widen_jobs_type_github_push`).

200.description: Idempotent replay — existing job for idempotency_key

402.description: Insufficient credits — top up (overdraft floor reached)

404.description: Project not found (github-push) — same Error shape

post.description: Accepts `multipart/form-data` with up to 3 image files (png/jpeg/webp, max 5MB each — same limits as `uploadPromptAttachments` in michelangelo-app). Optional text field `idempotency_key` (uuid, generated server-side when omitted). Uploads each to the private `job-attachments` bucket at `{user_id}/{idempotency_key}/image-{i}.{ext}` and returns the manifest to pass as `attachments` in `POST /v1/jobs` (`type=prompt`). Files stay in the transient bucket until the runner downloads and deletes them.

get.description: Polling endpoint. Clients should poll with backoff (suggested: 2s → 30s max). A future version may offer realtime delivery (SSE / Realtime) without changing this contract.

get.summary: List projects of the authenticated user
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own projects by default (`visibility=mine`). Pass `visibility=all` to also include public/shared community projects. RLS of the underlying backend applies on top: users can never see other people's private rows.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: `mine` (default): only the caller's own projects. `all`: own projects plus public/shared community projects.

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout Session for wallet top-up
post.description: Creates a one-time EUR Checkout Session (`mode: payment`) for the authenticated user. The app opens `checkout_url` in a browser/Desktop webview. Supports preset amounts (5, 20, 100, 200 EUR — matching the existing Stripe prices) or any custom whole-euro amount via `amount_eur`. Conversion is fixed: 1 EUR = 100 credits (1 credit = 1 EUR-cent), credited to `wallets.balance` by the Stripe webhook (`checkout.session.completed`). Pass `success_url`/`cancel_url` to deep-link back into Desktop/michelangelo-app (defaults come from server env).

post.summary: Stripe webhook — credits wallets on payment
post.description: Stripe calls this endpoint (no auth — verified via `Stripe-Signature` against `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`). Handles `checkout.session.completed` with `payment_status: paid`: idempotently inserts a `wallet_transactions` row (`reason: topup`) and increments `wallets.balance` by `credits` (1 EUR = 100 credits). Configure the URL in the Stripe Dashboard; keep the legacy Supabase `stripe-webhook` endpoint until traffic is migrated.

schema.description: Raw Stripe event payload (verified by signature)

200.description: Webhook received (or ignored for other event types)

patch.description: Mirrors `useRenameProject` (`{name}`) + `useToggleVisibility` (`{shared}`) in michelangelo-app. At least one of `name,shared,icon_url` required. RLS: only the owner can update.

get.summary: List files of a project (+ updated_at)
get.description: Selects `public.files` (`path,contents,type,updated_at`) ordered by path. Mirrors `use-project-files.ts` (which filters `type=CODE` client-side; pass `?type=CODE` for the same view). RLS: owner or shared project.

put.description: Body `{files:[{path,contents,type}]}`. Per file: `PATCH ?project_id=eq.X&path=eq.Y`, if zero rows then `POST`. Same result as `use-project-files.ts` save (which issues one update per file).

post.description: Proxies the Supabase `generate-project-icon` edge (`{project_id}`) with the user JWT. The edge reads `get_project_for_icon`, uploads `project-icons/{id}/{ts}.png`, then `update_project_icon`.
Mirrors `use-reshare.ts`: inserts `{project_id,reshared_by_user_id,platform,share_metadata}`. Duplicate (same project+user+platform) → 200 with `deduped:true` instead of an error.

get.description: Mirrors `use-preview-errors.ts` drain: selects `id,message,stack,created_at` for the project (max 10, oldest first). Pure by default; pass `?consume=true` to also delete the returned rows (what the app does after rendering them). RLS: project owner only.

get.summary: Supabase link of one project (safe columns only)
get.description: Selects `project_id,supabase_project_ref,supabase_project_name,api_url` from `supabase_project_links`. Mirrors the app read (never `anon_key` over this route). 404 when the project has no link.

Community feed: `shared=true` projects ordered by `updated_at` desc with cursor pagination (`?limit&cursor`). Mirrors `ProjectsProvider type='all'` (which pages 3 at a time). Optional `?q=` runs RPC `match_project` first and returns the matched project(s). `get_explore_projects` does not exist on the DB, so the feed is a filtered projects select (RLS `own OR shared`).

post.description: Mirrors `utils/project.ts:reportAlert`: inserts `{reporter_id,reported_project_id?,reported_user_id?,reason?}`. At least one target required. RLS `users can create reports`.
Mirrors `reportAlert` block path: inserts `{blocker_id,blocked_id}`. Duplicate → 200 `deduped:true`. Cannot block yourself → 400.

post.summary: OAuth code → token (secret never leaves the server)
post.description: Proxies the Supabase `github-token-exchange` edge with the user JWT: `{code,redirect_uri?}` → `{access_token}`. The GitHub client secret stays in edge secrets, never ships to the app. Mirrors `getGitHubToken` in michelangelo-app.

get.summary: GitHub App installations of the user (safe columns only)
get.description: Selects `id,login,avatar,name` from `github_installations` for the caller. Never exposes `ghu` (the stored OAuth token). Mirrors the installation picker in `components/github.tsx`.

post.description: Replaces `storeInstallation` in `use-github-mutations.ts` (which no longer writes to the DB — it only returns `{installation_id,profile}`). Upserts `{id,user_id,ghu,login,avatar,name}` on conflict `id`; `user_id` is always forced from the JWT (client value ignored). `ghu` (user OAuth token) is write-only — never returned. The webhook edge only refreshes rows, so without this call installations would never exist.

get.summary: Repos linked by the user (via their installations)

post.description: Mirrors the link step in `use-github-mutations.ts`: verifies the installation belongs to the caller, then upserts `{project_id,github_installation_id,github_repository_name,github_last_sync}` on conflict `project_id`. Defaults `github_repository_name` to `michelangelo-{project_id}` (app convention) when omitted.

404.description: Project or installation not found — same Error shape

delete.summary: Unlink repo from a project (delete github_repositories)
delete.description: Unblocks `useGitHubDisconnect` (which throws until this exists). Deletes the link row for `?project_id=` scoped to the caller's installations (a user can only unlink their own links). Idempotent: 204 even when no link exists.

post.summary: GitHub events (HMAC verified, no JWT — proxies github-webhook edge)
post.description: GitHub calls this endpoint (no auth — verified via `X-Hub-Signature-256` HMAC-SHA256 against `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, then forwarded to the Supabase `github-webhook` edge, which refreshes `github_installations` profile fields on `installation.created` and deletes the row on `installation.deleted`). Configure the URL in the GitHub App settings.

Proxies `GET connect-supabase/login` with the caller id from the JWT (`user_id`) plus the app PKCE `code_challenge`/`code_verifier?`. Returns `{authorize_url,return_url}` — the app opens `authorize_url` via `openAuthSessionAsync` and the edge deep-links back to `michelangelo://supabase-connected` after the callback stores the connection (tokens stay server-side in `supabase_connections`).

get.description: Proxies `GET connect-supabase/projects` with the user JWT (the edge refreshes the OAuth token as needed). Returns `{projects:[{ref,name,region,created_at,linked_project_id}],organizations}`. 404 `not_connected` when the Supabase account is not linked.

404.description: Supabase account not connected — same Error shape

post.description: Proxies `POST connect-supabase/link` (`{project_id,supabase_ref}`) with the user JWT. The edge verifies project ownership, Supabase-account ownership, 1:1 uniqueness (409 `already_linked`) and fetches the anon key server-side, then upserts `supabase_project_links`.

404.description: Project not found or Supabase not connected — same Error shape

409.description: Supabase project already backs another app

delete.description: Unblocks `useSupabaseUnlink` (which throws until this exists). Deletes the link row for `?project_id=` scoped to the caller (RLS `Users can manage own supabase project links`). Idempotent: 204 even when no link exists.

get.description: Selects `supabase_user_id,supabase_username` for the caller (never the OAuth tokens). `{connected:false}` when no row exists. Mirrors `use-supabase-connection.ts`.

Mirrors `use-credit-balance.ts:fetchCreditBalance` wallet leg: selects `balance,bonus_balance,bonus_expires_at` for the caller. Expired bonus is reported as 0 bonus (same rule as RPC `get_wallet_balance`). Unit is EUR-cent credits (1 EUR = 100 credits); `display_*` fields are preformatted server-side with `Intl.it-IT EUR` — clients render them verbatim and never compute `balance/100` themselves. New signups get a 500-credit (€5.00) welcome bonus valid 30 days; spend consumes bonus first, then paid balance, which may go down to −500 (−€5.00 overdraft) before `POST /jobs` returns `402 insufficient_credits`.

Per-generation spend log: every `spend` row carries `metadata` with `run_id`, `model`, `provider`, `cost_eur` ("1.05") and `display_cost` ("1,05 €") preformatted server-side — clients render `display_cost` verbatim so the user sees what each generation cost.
Proxies RPC `get_usage_summary(p_period,p_year,p_month)` as the user (`auth.uid()` inside). Mirrors `context/usage.tsx` (`month` + `all`).
Selects `notifications` for the caller ordered by `created_at` desc (limit 50 max client-side; API default 20). Includes `sender{username,avatar_url}` expansion.

patch.summary: Mark all as read (bulk update, mirrors markAllAsRead)
patch.description: Mirrors `markAllAsRead` in `push-notifications.tsx` (fired on blur of the notifications screen): sets `is_read=true` on all unread rows of the caller. Only `{is_read:true}` is accepted. Returns the updated count.
Mirrors single-read (`update{is_read:true}.eq(id).eq(recipient_id)`) in `push-notifications.tsx`. Body `{is_read:true}` (only true supported — unread is a fresh row, not a toggle).

post.description: Mirrors `savePushToken`/`savePushTokenToDB`: upserts `{user_id,token,device_type?,is_active:true,last_used_at,locale?,time_zone?}` on conflict `token`. RLS `Users can manage own push tokens`.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE, issued by the Michelangelo auth server on auth.michelangelo.land — the upstream backend is an implementation detail. Third-party clients register via Dynamic Client Registration at /auth/v1/oauth/clients/register. Data APIs live under api.michelangelo.land/v1.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase-issued JWT, validated by the API via JWKS

client_id.description: OAuth client the token was issued to

rate_limit.description: Current quota snapshot for this client (when available)

user_id.description: Auth user id (JWT sub, matches public.profiles.id)

email.description: Email from the validated JWT (mirrors auth.users.email)

Wallet.description: Wallet snapshot in minor units. 1 credit = 1 EUR-cent. Money math never uses floats: clients render `display_total` / `display_balance` verbatim and never divide `balance` themselves.

bonus_balance.description: Bonus in EUR-cent credits (0 when expired)

balance_eur.description: Paid balance as decimal EUR string with 2 decimals (no float)

metadata.description: Spend rows carry run_id, model, provider, cost_eur and display_cost; topup rows carry stripe_session_id and amount_eur.

path.description: Storage path in the job-attachments bucket (from POST /jobs/attachments)

attachments.description: Manifest entries from POST /jobs/attachments (stored in job_attachments + input.attachment_refs)

expo_push_token.description: Expo push token notified on completion (stored in input, mirrors sendPrompt)

live_activity_token.description: Live Activity push token (stored in input.live_activity_token, mirrors v9 enqueue)

live_activity_user.description: Live Activity user id (stored in input.live_activity_user, mirrors v9 enqueue)

supabase_project_ref.description: Linked Supabase ref for the runner (stored in input.supabase_project_ref, mirrors v9 enqueue)

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated v4 uuid (mirrors prompt idempotency); replay returns the existing job

type.description: Push the project to its linked GitHub repo via the github-actions edge

id.description: GitHub App installation id (upserted on conflict id)

ghu.description: User OAuth token (write-only, stored server-side, never returned)

user_id.description: Owner id (needed by feed/user screens to fetch the author profile)

shared.description: Community visibility (preview/feed only show shared projects)

author.description: Embedded author profile (username, avatar_url) via projects_user_id_fkey

PublicProfile.description: Public profile columns read by screens/user (feed hero)

amount_eur.description: Whole euros to charge (1 EUR = 100 credits, 1 credit = 1 EUR-cent). Presets in the app: 5, 20, 100, 200 — any integer 1..1000 accepted for custom amounts. Always charged in EUR.

success_url.description: Deep-link or https URL Stripe redirects to after payment. May contain `{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` placeholder. Defaults to server `BILLING_SUCCESS_URL` when omitted.

cancel_url.description: URL Stripe redirects to on cancel. Defaults to server `BILLING_CANCEL_URL` when omitted.

checkout_url.description: Open this URL in a browser to collect payment

credits.description: Credits the wallet receives once paid (1 EUR = 100 credits)

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired or invalid token / signature

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist (or is not visible to this token)

RateLimited.description: Quota exceeded; retry after the indicated time
